Marc: Heads-up — customer (Tier 1 finance) just dropped a long checklist. Locked DC, no egress, HSM-backed keys, quarterly maintenance freeze windows. Asking if we can do a USB delta path + signed minibundles. Also wants pricing impact for private vs dedicated. :grimacing:
Anya: thx Marc. Do they require image-level signing + SBOM or just package signing? Many gov customers ask for both.
Marc: CISO said must have SBOM + signed manifest chain. Also need proof-of-delivery + chain-of-custody (they prefer shipper receipts).
Priya: we can generate signed minibundles. Two options: full offline bundle (big) or chunked delta bundles with manifest.sig per chunk. Delta reduces transfer size but increases acceptance testing.
Hugo: security note — if we're allowing USB import, we need signed artifacts + verification steps. Recommend HSM for signing and provide offline verification tool that only uses local cert store. Also need guidance on root CA rotation in air-gapped sites.
Anya: quick sketch of a delta layout they can validate:
```
minibundle_v2.tar.gz
  ├─ manifest.json
  ├─ manifest.sig  # signed by Redwood HSM
  ├─ chunks/
  │   ├─ chunk-0001.tar.gz
  │   └─ chunk-0002.tar.gz
  └─ sbom.json
```
Verification on their side: `openssl dgst -sha256 -verify root_pub.pem -signature manifest.sig manifest.json`
Marc: they asked whether upgrade rollbacks are supported in the bootflow. Their ops team can only accept a single reboot window per month.
Ben: rollback support depends on how stateful the operator is. For our current onprem package we keep a staged image and metadata so we can rollback within the same major. We should document rollback SLA and retention.
Priya: suggestion: recommend a quarterly major upgrade cadence for full bundle, monthly minibundle hotfixes only if signed and size < 200MB. That maps to the customer's monthly reboot window for small fixes and a quarterly maintenance for majors.
Marc: pricing question — they want to know uplift for air-gapped private deployment vs hosted. Any quick numbers?
Ben: ballpark: Private deployment = platform fee + annual support + per-node runtime license. For sealed/offline we add an offline packaging fee and signed-bundle service. I can draft a sample term sheet.
Hugo: we should flag the SLA caveat: in sealed environments we can't promise automatic rollbacks or remote patching. Oncall response is manual. Also telemetry for health is limited; recommend a periodic health bundle they can run and send back via secure courier if needed.
Anya: actionable items: 1) confirm SBOM + signing requirements with customer (Marc) 2) ops runbook for USB import + verification (Priya) 3) draft pricing addendum for sealed deployment (Ben) 4) security Q responses re: root rotation + HSM (Hugo)
Marc: I'll confirm SBOM + acceptance criteria with their CISO tomorrow. Also they want sample runbook steps they can hand to their infra team. Can we draft a 1-page runbook? :+1:
Priya: yes, I'll put together a 1-pager with verification commands, checksums, and rollback steps. Will include `sha256sum` checks and the `openssl` verify snippet.
OpsBot: Deploy-checklist-bot: New checklist created — ID: DC-LOCKED-2024-09, assignees: Priya, Ben. :rocket:
Marc: one more ask — licensing: do we allow time-limited trial keys for air-gapped evals? customer wants 30d POC on-prem before a full license.
Ben: we support 30d trial keys for onprem, but for HSM-backed private installs we require a signed SOW + refundable commitment for support. I'll include that in the draft.
Hugo: send the security questionnaire answers to me before we share; I'll redline any details that leak architecture.
Anya: I'll draft the runbook + delta bundle spec and share in this thread by EOD.
Marc: awesome, thanks team. I'll update after the CISO call. :eyes:
